title: Healthy Habits
description: A busy office worker changes her daily habits to feel better.
instructions: Read the text about healthy habits, then choose the best answer (A, B, C or D) for each question.

paragraphs.text: Karen works in an office in the city centre. Last year, she often felt tired and had headaches. She drank five cups of coffee every day and sat at her computer for many hours. She went to bed after midnight almost every night.

In January, Karen decided to change some of her habits. She started to drink more water and only one cup of coffee in the morning. She also bought a bottle of water for her desk. Every hour, she stood up and walked around the office for a few minutes.

Karen also stopped taking the bus to work. Now she walks for twenty-five minutes every morning, even when it rains. She eats fruit for her snacks instead of biscuits. On Sundays, she cooks healthy meals for the whole week.

After three months, Karen felt much better. Her headaches were gone, and she had more energy at work. Now she goes to bed at ten thirty and sleeps well. Two of her colleagues are now walking to work with her.

At first, the changes were not easy for Karen. In the first week, she missed her coffee very much, and she felt angry in the mornings. Walking in the rain was cold and unpleasant. But her sister Julia called her every evening and said, 'Don't stop now. You are doing really well.' After two weeks, Karen did not want coffee in the afternoons any more, and the morning walk became her favourite part of the day.

In April, Karen joined a yoga class at a sports centre near her flat. The class is on Tuesday and Thursday evenings. At first, she could not touch her toes, but now she is much stronger. She has also stopped looking at her phone in bed. Instead, she reads a book for twenty minutes before she sleeps. She feels calmer now, and she gets up more easily in the morning.

Last month, Karen's company asked her to give a short talk about her healthy habits. She was nervous, but she told her story and gave some simple tips. After the talk, the company put water machines on every floor and started a walking club. Karen is the leader of the club, and twelve people now walk with her every Friday at lunchtime.
